audience: teams managing employee records, leave and payroll in Talenox

useCases.title: Review leave for a date range
useCases.text: List leave applications overlapping the selected dates, optionally narrowed by employee, approver or status, and inspect an application in detail.

useCases.title: Check an employee leave balance
useCases.text: Look up an employee and read their leave balances for a selected date and leave type before planning time off.

useCases.title: Review payroll run status
useCases.text: List a month’s payroll runs and inspect a selected run’s draft or processed state and export status. This does not process or publish payroll.

useCases.title: Approve a selected leave application
useCases.text: Read the application first, then approve it when the user confirms, using the approver’s token. Approval can affect balances and payroll and may notify the employee.
